units: metres, right-handed, +Y up, camera looks toward -Z at start
progress_source: single 0..1 value driven by scroll, drag, keys and playback
camera_owner: one director; in an existing project this is that project's owner

safe_focus_zone.use: hold here with progress and retry if task-room assets are missing

shots.name: Entry hold
shots.focal_subject: title panel on the wall left of the door, front-facing
shots.fallback: reduced motion: static frame with the same title and a Next control

shots.name: Through the door and down the corridor
shots.target_mode: look-ahead on spline, eased toward the media wall between z=-5.5 and z=-8.5
shots.speed: ease-in from rest, 1.8 m/s cruise, slows to 0.9 m/s beside the media wall, no stop

media.start: when the plane is in view and the frame is ready

shots.transition_in: doorway frame occludes the entry room; corridor light is visible before the door is crossed
shots.fallback: reduced motion: direct step to S3 with the media offered as a captioned still

shots.name: Task room
shots.focal_subject: workbench with the real task: input, validate, process, review
rules: camera does not move while the user types
navigation is disabled while a dialog owns input
progress and answers persist on leave and return
shots.output: a validated result object, passed to S5
shots.error: inline message at the bench, retry and cancel; no fabricated completion

shots.name: Turn and pass into the result room
shots.target_mode: look-ahead on spline; yaw change about 90 degrees spread over the first 60 percent
shots.speed: ease-in-out, peak 1.6 m/s, continuous velocity at both joins
shots.transition_in: door jamb passes close to camera on the left; result plinth is revealed past it

shots.name: Result hold
shots.focal_subject: the output from S3 on a plinth, with the call to action beside it
input: ArrowLeft travels back along the same spline

reverse: the same spline is retraced; media pauses when out of view; S3 answers are retained
